pp1_scope_policy.demonstration_floor: At least one primary predictor must produce retained real scores through the C3 interface; otherwise PP1 may demonstrate only the software pipeline and must not claim a predictor audit.
pp1_scope_policy.comparison_target: Integrate at least two primary predictors if both pass environment reproduction, score-semantic review, and a retained real-score smoke test before the PP1 cutoff.
pp1_scope_policy.single_predictor_label: If only one real predictor is ready, label the result a single-predictor pilot and do not present cross-predictor conclusions.
pp1_scope_policy.secondary_activation_rule: Do not spend PP1 critical-path time on Multi-AOP or AOP-DRL unless the primary path is blocked and the secondary candidate first becomes fully reproducible and licence-compatible.
pp1_scope_policy.integration_evidence_rule: A predictor remains not_integrated until its adapter produces a finite real score and the sequence, predictor version, score, runtime, and artifact hashes are retained.

priorities.rationale: The public repository bundles the SVM, scaler, selected-feature table, and inference code; it exposes one unambiguous positive-class probability and has a reachable web form. Its main risk is reproducing the legacy Python 3.7/scikit-learn 1.0.2 joblib environment.
next_actions: Create an isolated environment matching the published serialized-model dependencies.
Parameterize the hard-coded paths behind a C3 adapter.
Retain one real sequence, positive-class probability, model hashes, and environment versions.

priorities.rationale: Public source and TensorFlow checkpoint files are available and the DTU service is reachable, but the legacy TensorFlow environment must be reproduced and the two-output FRS/Chelator model requires a frozen scalar-score choice for C3.
next_actions: Freeze FRS, Chelator, or a prespecified combination as the C3 scalar before experimental scoring.
Reproduce local checkpoint inference or document a controlled service workflow.
Retain one real score with checkpoint/service version evidence.

priorities.rationale: PU-AOP is scientifically central to the project and local source/manifests exist, but Component 2 must select the frozen model and provide the ignored checkpoint, compatible feature resources, runtime contract, and reference score before C3 integration.
next_actions: Complete the Component 2 handoff checklist in this decision record.
Hash-verify the selected checkpoint and preprocessing lineage.
Verify the supplied reference score through the C3 adapter before marking integration.

priorities.rationale: Code and checkpoints exist, but the PyTorch Geometric/RDKit/xLSTM environment, hard-coded paths, 2-30 versus 50-residue behavior, and missing repository licence create more PP1 risk than the primary candidates.
next_actions: Defer until the primary set has at least one verified real integration.
Resolve dependency versions, input-length semantics, and reuse permission before activation.

priorities.rationale: The public repository lacks a trained checkpoint and complete inference package, the published endpoint is not serving AOP-DRL, and the stated non-commercial restriction requires clarification.
next_actions: Keep outside the PP1 critical path.
Reconsider only after obtaining an author-supplied checkpoint/inference procedure or a restored service and clarifying permitted use.

pu_aop_handoff.acceptance_gate: Every required item must be marked verified_for_handoff, all supplied hashes must match, and the supplied reference sequence must reproduce its expected finite score through the C3 predictor interface within the declared tolerance.
pu_aop_handoff.scientific_limitation: Component 2 reports weak assay-supported discrimination and states that model scores are not calibrated biological probabilities; C3 must preserve this limitation in every result.

requirements.evidence_or_request: Identify exactly one frozen PU-AOP model/version for the audit; the existing freeze manifest contains five baseline models and a three-stage curriculum, so C3 will not guess.
Provide the selected checkpoint binary. Existing accepted checkpoint paths point under ignored data/interim/c2_pu run directories that are absent here.
Provide the selected checkpoint SHA-256 and confirm it against data/processed/c2_pu/C2_PP1_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json.
Confirm the selected model's fold and scaler from data/processed/c2_pu/fr3_fusion_scalers.json; file SHA-256 83a414b29e1ba057e36a9de4fb1efb5858933ae2feb2c75713555fddcbb90169.
Confirm esm2_t12_35M_UR50D, representation layer 12, 480-dimensional residue-mean embedding, exact dependency/runtime, and model-weight provenance.
Confirm descriptors_v1, all 15 ordered descriptor names, implementation commit, and any dependency versions.
Provide a read-only sequence-to-score command/function or exact steps that do not retrain, refit a scaler, or rewrite accepted Component 2 artifacts.
Confirm positive-class orientation, native range, threshold if applicable, whether any clipping occurs, and the required statement that the score is not a calibrated biological probability.
Provide at least one valid peptide sequence, expected native score, numerical tolerance, model/scaler/checkpoint hashes, and runtime versions for cross-component verification.
Specify supported sequence lengths/alphabet, practical batch size, deterministic settings, and failure behavior for invalid or unscorable inputs.
Confirm internal research use, redistribution/storage rules for ignored model artifacts, and the approved handoff location.
